id: title:cat-ph:keep selection when linking an existing issue

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the frontend form and component props for selecting an external issue, while backend implementation and database migration are absent.

P1.F1.H1 updates the form field and submission handler, P1.F1.H2 updates component props, and P1.F1.H3 preserves selection state. review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned conservatively as Tier 1 because the backend implementation and database migration are absent, preventing an assessment of systemic risk reduction or broader capability. The score reflects the observed frontend changes without inferring backend behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the backend API implementation or database migration, so the tier cannot be established. The frontend changes alone do not demonstrate systemic risk reduction or broader capability. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: The hunk P1.F1.H1 changes the form and its props, replacing the field name and its associated value type from 'externalContext' to 'externalIssue'. It also updates the onSubmit handler to pass the selected issue's external context to the parent, while removing the old field and its associated error and submission handling.
observations.posthog_connection: This changes the frontend form used to link an existing issue from an external error tracking provider. The backend API and database are not shown, so the tier cannot be established.

observations.behavior: The hunk P1.F1.H2 changes the props of the ExistingIssueSelect component, updating the value and onChange types to use the new ErrorTrackingExternalIssueResultApi type instead of the previous external context type.
observations.posthog_connection: This changes the frontend component props, not the backend implementation. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: The hunk P1.F1.H3 adds a selectedKey and an options array, and adds a check to preserve the selected option in the dropdown even if the fresh results no longer include it. This prevents the selection from disappearing when the results are refreshed.
observations.posthog_connection: This changes the frontend component, not the backend implementation. No score assigned.
